Overview

Poprad is a city in Prešov Region with a population of 51,286. The gateway to the High Tatras, Slovakia’s most beautiful mountain range, a popular base for hiking, skiing, and exploring the Tatra National Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
